entities.name: AhpD alkyl hydroperoxide reductase
observations: The 180-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q0BXT2 AhpD from Hyphomonas neptunium.
AhpD reduces the oxidized active-site cysteine residues of AhpC and regenerates AhpC peroxiredoxin activity.
Reviewed homologs assign EC 1.11.1.28 and disulfide oxidoreductase/peroxiredoxin-related activity.
Conserved catalytic-region evidence includes a proton donor at position 131 and a cysteine sulfenic-acid intermediate at position 134; these residues can form an interchain disulfide with AhpC.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence match and curated AhpD annotation

entities.name: AhpD hydroperoxide reduction
observations: Rhea-mapped overall reaction: N(6)-[(R)-dihydrolipoyl]-L-lysyl-[lipoyl-carrier protein] plus a hydroperoxide yields N(6)-[(R)-lipoyl]-L-lysyl-[lipoyl-carrier protein], an alcohol, and water.
The enzyme is a redox relay: it transfers reducing equivalents from reduced lipoyl groups to the AhpC active-site cysteine system, enabling hydroperoxide reduction.

entities.name: AhpD CMD domain
observations: Pfam scanning detected CMD domain PF02627.27 at positions 99-176, consistent with the C-terminal catalytic region of AhpD-like proteins.
